# University of Bielefeld - Faculty Homepages

> Academic resource hub featuring linguistic research, phonetic references, and formal grammar frameworks from University of Bielefeld faculty.

This site hosts faculty homepages and research materials from the University of Bielefeld, with a focus on computational linguistics, formal syntax, and language resources. It serves as a repository for academic papers, linguistic data, and pedagogical materials.

## Key Topics

- Mandarin Pinyin
- Minimalist Grammars
- Formal Linguistics
- Computational Linguistics
- Edward Stabler
- TAG (Tree Adjoining Grammar)
- Proof Nets
- Type Logical Tradition
- Syllable Reference
- Chinese Language
- Syntax
- Derivations
- Probabilistic Minimalist Grammars

## Linguistic Resources & References

- [Mandarin Pinyin Syllable Chart (He 2004)](https://wwwhomes.uni-bielefeld.de/gibbon/Syllables/Mandarin/He-PinyinChart.html): Comprehensive Mandarin Pinyin syllable chart reference based on He 2004 standard for phonetic and language learning purposes

## Formal Linguistics & Grammar Theory

- [Edward Stabler - Minimalist Grammars (Abstract)](https://wwwhomes.uni-bielefeld.de/jmichaelis/shop98/stabler.html): Abstract on Edward Stabler's work on minimalist grammars and formal linguistics approaches to syntax and derivation
